## Change and scope

Describe what changed and why. Identify the affected rule/source/version if applicable.

## Verification actually performed

List actual commands or manual steps, environments, outcomes, and evidence. Explicitly list checks not run and remaining limitations.

## Rights and publication review

Confirm that the contribution contains no credentials or private data and identify third-party material and its terms. By contributing, you offer code and data under the MIT License and prose under CC BY 4.0, as scoped in `LICENSE-DOCS.txt`.
